newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares, Bunds drop on Greenspan comments.
newsitem.headline: German shares, Bunds drop on Greenspan comments.

text.p: German shares and Bunds slid after the release of eagerly awaited comments from U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan, who said he saw an upside risk on inflation and would not rule out a pre-emptive rate rise.
The IBIS DAX index, which had been up about 0.6 percent, dropped around one percent to a low of 3,216.94 points on the comments, before paring losses to 3,226.30 points, down 7.04 points.
March Bund futures slid on the news, but strongly outperformed U.S. Treasuries. The DTB March Bund futures contract was down 31 basis points near technical support at 103.04.
